discussion_comments.comment_body: This duplicates existing code. `core/services/cloud-handoff/git-preflight.ts` (#15219) already normalizes the remote and checks the branch and upstream, and `createWorkspaceGitReader` in `workspace-manifest.ts` already reads remotes and refs. Please reuse those, or put this snapshot logic in core next to `git-preflight` instead of keeping a second git runner in the app.

We have a number of config.outputMode === "json" type branches here already. Could we look at making a role interface and, at the start, new up a "Json outputter" or a "console outputter" or whatever we have so we don't have to keep threading these conditionals through the code?

Already this if-else shows some things don't make sense... like "verbose json" output doesn't print model provider info. IF those are orthogonal, the code should reflect that and have the verbosity flow to all outputters.

It is OK if some outputters ignore calls they don't care about, but it will help clarify what the purpose of these events are, like "this is the start of a session run", etc. by choosing good method names.

Thanks — I refactored the run path around a `RunOutputter` role (`JsonRunOutputter` / `ConsoleRunOutputter`) created once at the start of `runAgent`. The `outputMode` branch is now isolated to the factory; lifecycle output uses straight-line calls (`runStarted`, `runResult`, `runAborted`, etc.), and `verbose` is passed into both outputters. Verified `bun -F @cline/cli typecheck`, Biome on the changed files, and `run-agent.test.ts` (22 passed). Pushed in `f8405b5`.

Similar to feedback on your other PR, I suggest using a string union here instead of a boolean. Booleans often are not flexible enough to model what is going on, and tend to proliferate. Then you get a lot of booleans where a subset of the states are invalid and it gets confusing and hard to test.

Import the existing check from `@cline/shared`. `node:path` isn't needed after this change.

```suggestion
import {
	augmentNodeCommandForDebug,
	getShellKind,
	withResolvedClineBuildEnv,
```

`getShellKind` in `@cline/shared` already does this check, so this function can go.


Maintainability suggestion: could we generalize the existing formatHookContextBlock instead of adding a second formatter with the same text trimming, tag escaping, and wrapper construction? A discriminated union for run-start versus tool-hook context would let one formatter always emit source, and emit tool_name/tool_call_id only for the tool variant. This keeps the escaping rules in one place without passing empty or fabricated tool identities. Please retain coverage for embedded hook_context tags and the existing tool attributes.
done — one formatter, origin union. tool attrs only on the tool variant
